BiblicalUsage: Barak was the captain Deborah summoned to gather ten thousand men at Mount Tabor. He refused to go without her, pursued Sisera's chariots to the river Kishon, and sang with Deborah after the victory.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Barak's hesitation is honest and his obedience is real, because he went, even when he wanted Deborah beside him. God gave the victory to a man who asked for help, and I hold that asking for a godly companion is not weak faith but wise faith.
